Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Damage against <void/>Void-Debuffed enemies is increased per unique <void/>Void-Debuff applied to the target.

Damage is increased by 10%|20|30% at 1|2|3 Debuffs.

Due to an unresolved bug, this catalyst does not function. 

The intended behavior was that damage against <void/>Void-Debuffed enemies is increased per unique <void/>Void-Debuff applied to the target, at a rate of 10% per debuff.
